h: The Land of Canaan Becomes a Marketplace for Torah

p: כִּי אַתֶּם בָּאִים אֶל הָאָרֶץ כְּנָעַן (בְּמִדְבַּר לד, ב)
"For you are coming into the land, Canaan" (Bamidbar 34:2).
בְּמִדְרַשׁ רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ (בְּמִדְבַּר רַבָּה כג, י)
In the Midrash Rabbah on this parsha (Bamidbar Rabbah 23:10):
whose traders are the honored of the earth.'"
This is astonishing — that this should be
that it is a land of commerce!
when Yisrael were settled in their place,
and they did not engage in commerce.
in the Midrash mentioned above (Bamidbar Rabbah 23:12):
'The power of His works He told to His people,' etc.
אָמַר לָהֶם הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לְיִשְׂרָאֵל
HaKadosh Baruch Hu said to Yisrael:
I could have created for you
but in order to show you
I slay your enemies before you
'to give them the inheritance of the nations.'"
He had already shown His power
the seven nations are called "your enemies";
the Egyptians, who enslaved them with crushing labor,
and He should have given Yisrael
it is known that "one opposite the other
and just as there are ten sefiros in holiness,
and seven sefiros of the structure,
and they are the three kelipos
are the dross of Avraham and Yitzchak,
the aspects of Chessed and Gevurah,
which are branches of Chochmah and Binah
so in the kelipah "the first of nations,"
And from them branched out the seven nations,
"You shall not let any soul live";
and each one is composed of ten,
these being the seventy kelipos of the nations,
which are "according to the number of the Children of Israel."
And every nation has in it
"And You give life to them all."
And the seven nations as a whole
are called by the name of Canaan.
This is what the Midrash says,
that it is a land of commerce,
and the nations of the world
along the lines of what is said (Hoshea 12:8):
"A merchant, in whose hand are false scales";
which is the power of Torah
"The power of His works He told to His people":
that He could have created a new land,
ko'ach mah, the letters of chochmah
is in the secret of Chochmah,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א רלד, ב)
that He could have created a new land,
This is along the lines of
what they said in the Gemara (Pesachim 87b):
that converts be added to them";
that is, the holy sparks within them;
and from this it comes about
that is, all the seven kelipos
that include all the seventy nations;
and that is the leaven in the dough.
וּבְמִדְרַשׁ רַבָּה (וַיֵּרָא פָּרָשָׁה נד, בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה נד, א)
and in the Midrash Rabbah (Vayeira, parsha 54, Bereishis Rabbah 54:1):
גַּם אוֹיְבָיו יַשְׁלִים אִתּוֹ (מִשְׁלֵי טז, ז)
"'Even his enemies He makes to be at peace with him' (Mishlei 16:7)
"to give them the inheritance of the nations":
that is, "the ko'ach of His works,"
are called by the name of Canaan,
where one can trade in words of Torah.
And the main thing is Torah she'b'al peh,
"For its trade is better than the trade of silver."
כִּי לֶקַח טוֹב וְגוֹ׳ (מִשְׁלֵי ד, ב)
"'For I have given you good merchandise,' etc. (Mishlei 4:2):
Is there any commerce better than this?"
it is called the land of Canaan,
which is better than the trade of silver.
And they, the nations of the world,
took for themselves the evil opposite,
in whose hand are false scales."
did not take up the trade of silver;
they sat each man under his vine
"Portions have fallen to me in pleasant places"
and they merited Torah she'b'al peh,
whose essence is in Eretz Yisrael,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה טז, ד)
וּזְהַב הָאָרֶץ הַהִוא טוֹב (בְּרֵאשִׁית ב, יב)
"'And the gold of that land is good' (Bereishis 2:12):
there is no Torah like the Torah of Eretz Yisrael,
like the wisdom of Eretz Yisrael."
to trade in the commerce of Torah she'b'al peh;
and on the days of work
they merit the garments of mitzvos
that depend on working the soil,
as they said in the Midrash (Tanchuma, end of Shelach; Tanchuma Buber Shelach 28):
